text:
maria: FYI we just ran into a bad sequence: regional collector went OOS and a tenant's OTLP exporter hogged sockets with long gRPC retries, causing downstream queueing and delayed traces.
kevin: noticed the socket exhaustion pattern in telemetry stubs. no circuit-breaker per-tenant, and retries were aggressive.
sam: what did their exporter look like? gRPC or HTTP?
maria: gRPC. runtime auto-injected config (pasted):
```
exporter:
  protocol: otlp_grpc
  endpoints:
    - collector-eu.internal:4317
  per_attempt_timeout_ms: 30000
  retry_policy:
    max_retries: 7
    initial_backoff_ms: 200
    max_backoff_ms: 8000
    multiplier: 2.0
```
kevin: ugh 30s per attempt * 7 = way too long in the face of a regional outage. also no jitter -> thundering retries.
ruchi: proposal: add per-exporter circuit-breaker + failover order. if CB trips, switch to sampled ingestion and emit events. keep a small local buffer.
sam: agree. also cap aggregate concurrent streams per-tenant so a noisy tenant can't starve the HTTP/2 connection pool. consider HTTP/JSON as a thin fallback too.
maria: prefer runtime-first solution for Private deployments (no envoy dependency). hosted infra can use platform envoy for smarter routing.
kevin: new config fields idea (proto):
```
exporter:
  priority: "gold"
  failover: ["collector-local","collector-global","ingest-sink-sampled"]
  circuit_breaker:
    failure_threshold: 4
    reset_interval_ms: 60000
    max_open_ms: 180000
  concurrency_limit: 8
```
kevin: runtime behavior: separate conn pools per priority, per-tenant quotas, CB state machine with exponential backoff + full jitter.
otel-bot: metric proposals created: otlp.exporter.circuit_state, otlp.exporter.failover_count, otlp.exporter.concurrency_dropped, otlp.exporter.attempt_latency_p50/95/99.
sam: Console needs an "Exporter health" card per-tenant: current circuit state, last failover time, active endpoint, and recent latency p95. also a global heatmap of failovers by collector.
ruchi: defaults: priority mapping = usage tier -> priority, CB threshold = 4, reset_window = 60s, default concurrency_limit = 8, fallback mode = sample-only. need to draft exact numbers and rationale.
kevin: implementation plan: runtime change + proto extensions + opt-in feature flag. roll out to beta tenants then enable global. will open RFC/PR.
maria: ops: prepare stress tests simulating collector loss and large tenant bursts. infra-ci can run the job.
infra-ci: queued "otlp-conn-flood-test" with T-14 scenario, will post results and histograms.
sam: small UX ask for rollouts page: show exporter-level toggles and a mini timeline of CB open/close events for each tenant.
kevin: can we standardize on full jitter backoff? prevents synchronized retries.
ruchi: yes, full jitter. also put a hard cap on total retry duration per trace export request (e.g., 20s) separate from per-attempt timeout.
maria: action items:
- kevin: RFC + proto change + PoC in runtime (ETA EOW for draft PR)
- sam: Console mockups + alert rules (failover_count > 5 in 5m -> P3)
- ruchi: policy defaults doc + mapping for priority tiers
- maria: pick beta tenants and coordinate with product/ops
- infra-ci: run stress tests once PoC lands
kevin: PR link (WIP): https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/runtime/pulls/201
sam: I'll drop screenshots in this thread when UI mocks are ready.
maria: thanks all. final note: for Private customers we'll ship a small local proxy config and runtime fallback so they don't need platform envoy. will update onboarding docs.
kevin: locking on CB threshold=4, reset_interval=60s, concurrency_limit=8, use full jitter.
ruchi: documenting that now.
otel-bot: alert created: otlp.exporter.failover_rate > 5/min -> paging on-call.
maria: closing loop; will update incident runbook with manual mitigation steps if collector region degrades.
